description: Building production-quality mobile applications: the history and characteristics of mobile frameworks, the Android framework and application models, mobile UI design, local data, cloud integration, networking and hardware, enterprise requirements, testing, and publishing to the store, with a complete app shipped by the end. Taught to the depth of a leading mobile development course.
modelledOn: Android Developers documentation and the Modern Android Development guides
Phillips, Stewart, Marsicano and Gardner, Android Programming: The Big Nerd Ranch Guide
Apple Human Interface Guidelines and Flutter documentation for cross-platform comparison
outcomes: Compare native, cross-platform and web approaches to mobile development and choose for a given product.
Build Android apps with activities, fragments, navigation, lifecycle-aware components and Jetpack libraries.
Design mobile interfaces that follow platform guidelines and work on small, slow and offline devices.
Store data locally with preferences, files and a database and synchronise with cloud services.
Use networking, sensors, location, camera and background work correctly and efficiently.
Meet enterprise requirements for performance, scalability, modifiability, availability and security, test the app, and publish and maintain it.

units.title: Characteristics and history of mobile application frameworks
topics: From J2ME and Symbian to iOS and Android; the app store model
Constraints: battery, memory, screen, touch, connectivity, interruptions, fragmentation
Native (Kotlin/Android, Swift/iOS), cross-platform (Flutter, React Native, Kotlin Multiplatform), progressive web apps; trade-offs
Mobile in Ghana: Android dominance, low-end devices, data cost, USSD and SMS fallbacks

units.title: Android framework overview
topics: Android architecture: Linux kernel, ART, framework, apps; the SDK, Android Studio, emulators and real devices
Kotlin essentials for Android: null safety, lambdas, coroutines
Project structure, Gradle, the manifest, resources and configuration qualifiers
Activities and their lifecycle; intents and intent filters; permissions model
Debugging, logging and the profiler

units.title: Application models
topics: Components: activities, services, broadcast receivers, content providers; tasks and the back stack
Architecture: MVVM with ViewModel and LiveData/StateFlow; repository pattern; dependency injection (Hilt)
Fragments and the Navigation component; single-activity apps
Process lifecycle, configuration changes and saving state

units.title: User-interface design for mobile
topics: Layouts: ConstraintLayout and Jetpack Compose; lists with RecyclerView and LazyColumn
Material Design: components, theming, typography, dark mode; adaptive layouts for phones and tablets
Input, gestures, animation, accessibility (TalkBack, content descriptions, touch targets)
Localisation (Twi, Ga, Ewe, French), right-to-left support, offline and error states
Designing for low-end devices and slow networks

units.title: Managing application data
topics: SharedPreferences and DataStore; internal and external storage; scoped storage
SQLite with Room: entities, DAOs, migrations, queries as Flows
Content providers and sharing data between apps
Caching strategies and offline-first design

units.title: Integrating cloud services
topics: Firebase or Supabase: authentication, realtime database or Postgres, storage, push notifications, analytics, crash reporting
Synchronisation and conflict resolution; background sync with WorkManager
Payments: mobile money APIs and in-app billing
Backend-as-a-service versus a custom REST or GraphQL API

units.title: Networking, OS and hardware integration
topics: HTTP with Retrofit/OkHttp or Ktor; JSON parsing; handling slow and failing networks; image loading
Coroutines and threading; services, foreground services and WorkManager; notifications
Location and maps, camera and media, sensors, Bluetooth and NFC; runtime permissions
Battery and data efficiency; Doze and app standby

units.title: Enterprise requirements
topics: Performance: startup time, jank, memory leaks, profiling tools, baseline profiles
Scalability and modifiability: modular architecture, feature modules, clean architecture, API versioning
Availability: offline operation, retry and backoff, graceful degradation
Security: secure storage (Keystore), certificate pinning, obfuscation, OWASP Mobile Top Ten, data protection compliance

units.title: Testing
topics: Unit tests with JUnit and mocking; testing ViewModels and repositories; coroutine tests
Instrumented and UI tests with Espresso and Compose testing; screenshot tests
Test pyramid for mobile; device farms and emulator matrices; CI for Android
Beta testing with internal and closed tracks; collecting feedback

units.title: Publishing, deployment and maintenance
topics: App signing, Play Console, store listing, content ratings, privacy policy and data safety forms; iOS App Store comparison
Release management: versioning, staged rollouts, feature flags, in-app updates
Monitoring crashes, ANRs, performance and reviews; analytics and A/B tests
Maintenance: dependency updates, OS version migrations, deprecations
Capstone: a complete app for a local need (market prices, clinic appointments, transport) published to a test track

schedule.title: The mobile landscape
schedule.exercise: Write a comparison of native, cross-platform and progressive web app approaches for a market-price app aimed at low-end Android phones.

tasks.title: Switch the emulator between airplane mode, low battery and rotation and record what each change does to a sample app
Test a sample app on a low-memory 360 pixel wide device profile and list three layout or performance problems found
Draw architecture diagrams for a mobile money balance app built natively and as a PWA, and compare size, offline support and update cost

schedule.title: Android foundations and Kotlin
schedule.exercise: Explain the roles of the manifest, resources and Gradle in a project and list which files change when adding a Twi translation.

tasks.title: Create a hello app screen, add a string resource and a French variant, and switch the emulator language to confirm both display
Write Kotlin-style functions using null safety and lambdas that filter a list of 12 market prices and handle missing values
Use coroutine-style concurrency to fetch three simulated price sources in parallel, merge the results and handle one failing source

schedule.title: Activities, intents and permissions
schedule.exercise: Draw the activity lifecycle and mark which callbacks run when the user presses home, then returns, then rotates.

tasks.title: Log lifecycle callbacks while opening, rotating and leaving an activity, and match each log line to the user action
Start a second screen with an intent carrying a product ID and return a result, then handle a denied camera permission gracefully
Use logs and the profiler to find why a sample app leaks memory on rotation, then fix it and confirm usage stays flat

schedule.title: Components and architecture
schedule.exercise: Sketch the MVVM layers for a clinic appointment list and write where each piece of state should live.

tasks.title: Show a counter that resets on rotation, then keep its value with saved instance state or a ViewModel and verify it survives
Build a two-screen navigation graph with a list and a detail screen and confirm the back stack behaves correctly on back presses
Draw a component diagram for a market price app with repository, ViewModel and data sources and trace one refresh request through it

schedule.title: User interface design
schedule.exercise: Review a screenshot of a form against touch-target, contrast and content description rules, listing five fixes.

tasks.title: Lay out a scrollable list of 20 products with name, price and an image placeholder and check it on phone and tablet sizes
Apply a theme with light and dark colours and test that text contrast remains legible on both when the emulator theme changes
Make a payment form accessible with content descriptions, 48 dp touch targets and focus order, then step through it with the screen reader view

schedule.title: Localisation and low-end design
schedule.exercise: Write a list of text and layout problems likely when translating an English app into Twi and Ewe, with fixes.

tasks.title: Add Twi strings for a login screen, switch the device language and check that all labels change without truncation
Add empty, loading and error states to a list screen and test each by toggling the network and clearing the data
Reduce an image-heavy list screen's data use on a slow network profile by resizing images and lazy loading, then compare bytes transferred

schedule.title: Local storage and offline-first
schedule.exercise: Decide where to store a user token, a settings flag and 5000 price records, and justify each choice for security and speed.

tasks.title: Save a user's language choice in preferences, restart the app and confirm the setting is restored on the settings screen
Design a Room-style schema with products and orders tables, write the DAO queries as SQL and test them on sample rows
Build an offline-first price list that shows cached data instantly, refreshes when online and marks stale entries after 24 hours

schedule.title: Backend services, sync and payments
schedule.exercise: Compare a backend-as-a-service with a custom REST API for a clinic app, including cost, control and data protection.

tasks.title: Sign in with a test account, store one record in the cloud backend and read it back on a second emulator profile
Queue three edits made offline and sync them when the network returns, checking the server holds each edit once
Implement a mobile money payment flow against a sandbox API with pending, success and failure outcomes and an idempotent retry

schedule.title: Networking, background work and sensors
schedule.exercise: List the background tasks a delivery app needs and say which should use a foreground service and which a scheduled worker.

tasks.title: Parse a JSON response of 10 products, handle a missing field and a malformed payload, and print a clear message for each failure
Schedule a background sync every 15 minutes, show a notification on completion and verify it still runs after the app is closed
Use simulated location and the camera permission to build a delivery check-in, then reduce its battery use under Doze restrictions

schedule.title: Quality attributes
schedule.exercise: Rank performance, availability and security risks of a mobile wallet app and propose one mitigation for each.

tasks.title: Measure cold start time of a sample app, remove two blocking calls from startup and confirm the time drops
Add retry with exponential backoff to a failing request and test that the app degrades gracefully on a flaky network profile
Audit a seeded wallet app for insecure storage, missing certificate pinning and exported components, and fix the top three issues

schedule.title: Testing mobile apps
schedule.exercise: Design a test pyramid for a booking app and state how many tests of each kind you would run on every commit.

tasks.title: Write five unit tests for a price calculation function with a mocked repository, covering a normal, a zero and an error input
Script a UI test that logs in, adds an item and checks the total, then run it on phone and tablet profiles
Run a test suite across a matrix of 6 device profiles and Android versions, group failures by cause and fix the most common

schedule.title: Release and operations
schedule.exercise: Complete a store listing draft with description, content rating answers and a privacy policy outline for a clinic appointment app.

tasks.title: Fill in a store listing and data safety form for a sample app so that every declared permission matches what the app actually uses
Plan a staged rollout at 5, 25 and 100 percent and use a feature flag to turn off a faulty feature without a new release
Read a dashboard of crash and ANR data for a released app, find the top crash by affected users and write a fix plan

schedule.title: Maintenance and capstone
schedule.exercise: Demo your capstone app, show its test results and release notes, and explain how you would maintain it for two years.

tasks.title: Update a deprecated API call in a short code sample to its replacement and run the sample's tests to confirm behaviour is unchanged
Migrate a sample app to a newer OS version profile, fix the permission and background-limit breakages and retest the main flows
Build a complete clinic appointment or market price app with offline mode, tests and a release checklist, and submit it to a test track
